planned_validations: Bound directory/set/ref-list/annotation/array sections before reads; checked length/index/offset arithmetic.
Directory field/method/parameter entries strictly ordered by proper local index; target owners match class; parameter positions bind actual prototype parameter list.
Set entries ordered by annotation type_idx; annotation element names strictly ordered by name_idx; visibility exactly 0,1,2.
Encoded tag and value_arg width checked per kind; preserve original payload bytes and source ranges.
Signed values sign-extend; char/index values zero-extend; float/double right-zero-extend into original bits; preserve NaN payloads and infinities without JSON null substitution.
Validate string/type/field/method/proto/method-handle indices and DEX version restrictions; unknown tag remains InvalidInput rather than fallback unsupported.
Use shared maximum depth, node count, array count and byte budget, with explicit quota errors and no partial-ready facts.
Preserve depth, traversal ordinal, array element position and named-element identity separately, then project only after reference behavior is observed.
Signature fragments concatenate in encoded array order even if their string_idx or lexical value order differs.

cases: class, static/instance field, direct/virtual method annotations
two parameter positions with an empty ref slot
shared annotation_set used by multiple owners
method_idx equals field_idx without mixing kinds
at least three Signature string fragments whose array order differs from lexical/string_idx order
same local type/string indices in two DEX occurrences
non-string Signature value diagnosed separately from ordinary typed annotation fact
float/double compressed low-byte forms, finite/negative-zero/NaN/infinity bits
nested array, nested annotation, null and boolean
unsorted/duplicate annotation types or element names
wrong class owner or parameter list length
reused objects and traversal cannot create loops or duplicate semantic owner bindings
